name: com.atlanticagenticlabs/ask
title: Atlantic Agentic Labs
description: Search and read the public LightHouse™ documentation and Atlantic's published items.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Atlantic's public LightHouse™ documentation, including the API reference (OpenAPI) and the MCP tool reference. Use it for any question about what LightHouse does and how: connectors, agents, approvals, spend limits, evidence, security, deployment, the API, the MCP server and the CLI. Returns up to `limit` passages, best first, each quoted exactly with a deep link (`url`), the docs version and build date; `covered` is false when the documentation does not answer the query. Read only: no answer is generated and nothing is changed.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words or the exact terms the documentation would use. One topic per call. Examples: "how are approvals enforced", "connect Amazon S3", "POST /api/v1/keys", "hosted MCP OAuth scopes".
query.title: Query

limit.description: How many passages to return (1 to 8).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: search_published_knowledge
tools.description: Search the items Atlantic Agentic Labs has published about how it works: how engagements run, its technology partners, its positioning and its use cases. Use it for questions about Atlantic as a company rather than the product's mechanics. Returns passages quoted exactly, each with a link to the published item, its revision and publication date; `covered` is false when nothing published answers the query. It gives no prices or commercial terms: such a query returns a fixed note and no passages. Examples: "how does an engagement start", "which clouds does Atlantic deploy to".

query.description: What to look for, in plain words or the exact terms the documentation would use. One topic per call. Examples: "how are approvals enforced", "connect Amazon S3", "POST /api/v1/keys", "hosted MCP OAuth scopes".
query.title: Query

limit.description: How many passages to return (1 to 8).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: The public documentation's table of contents: for each page its section, title, path, URL and a one-line description, in the order the site shows them, with the list of sections, showing what the documentation covers. Optional `section` (one of the returned `sections`, matched without regard to case) narrows the list.

section.description: A section name from `sections`; omit for every page.
section.title: Section

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: One public documentation page as Markdown, exactly as published, with its title, canonical URL, section and the date it last changed. It takes a path or URL on the documentation site, such as "/mcp/public/" or "https://docs.atlanticagenticlabs.com/mcp/public/". Only pages of the public documentation site are served: any other address, and any page not in the published index, is refused. A very long page is truncated, with a note and the URL of the full page.

path.description: The page's path or full URL on docs.atlanticagenticlabs.com.
path.title: Path
